name: Tsuzuraorizaka Fuhito
source:
“The time has come for you to appear: the Realm of Night and all who inhabit it!!”

A tiny girl of unknown age sits in the principal’s seat at Libra Lapis Lazuli Private Academy. People just call her “Principal.” She has a carefree attitude and expresses her emotions extremely dramatically, like an unpredictable clown. She’ll laugh at anything, regardless of whether it’s actually funny or not. Although she looks like a little girl, she actually works to raise funds for the school, and teaches classes in the Realm of Night. She’s working both early in the morning and late at night, so no one knows when exactly she sleeps. Being at the center of the school’s administration makes her a suspicious character who must be hiding many secrets.

[From the [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/leyline/]English official site[/url].]
translation:
“让你现身的时刻到了：夜之国，以及居住其中的所有人！！”

一名年龄不详的小女孩坐在拉比拉斯·拉祖利私立学园的校长席上。人们只称她为“校长”。她性格随意，表达情绪时极其夸张，像个不可预测的小丑。无论是否真的好笑，她都会对任何事发笑。虽然看上去像小女孩，但她实际上负责为学校筹款，也在夜之国授课。她清晨和深夜都在工作，所以没人知道她究竟什么时候睡觉。身处学校行政中心的她，显然隐藏着许多秘密，是个可疑人物。

[来源：[url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/leyline/]英文官方网站[/url]。]
